scope: Repeatedly consumed historical terminal comparisons; 987 later games, no fresh validation.
selection_note: passes_score_screen records the originally frozen numerical screen without alteration. Requiring a correction also to outperform the existing BASE/G is an additional closeout decision made after inspecting results, not a preregistered gate. U controls passing the original screen must be reported as such. If only such weaker controls pass, the planned 99-refit extension is not executed; this scope adjustment does not resolve training uncertainty or exclude those mechanisms. No default model changes.
